purpose: Developer feasibility check, not phenomenon confirmation or method evaluation

denominator: Retain all four planned cells. Record not-started/failed/invalid cells explicitly. No success-only aggregate, deletion, replacement, retry or imputation.
failure_rule: Infrastructure, timeout, provider/token-count, journal or environment failure stops remaining jobs. A terminal syntactically invalid model action is a recorded cell outcome; other fixed jobs continue unchanged.
statistics: Descriptive paired cell comparison only. No population significance claim, confidence interval or pseudo-replication from four conditions.

Both cache prices remain below SQL price; this does not reverse route-cost preference
Classical grouped-view selection already solves this positive control; success is not a new algorithmic capability

next_decision: If technical failures occur, diagnose them before proposing any new version.
